verses.en: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;
verses.pt: E os filhos de Rúben e os filhos de Gade tinham uma muito grande abundância de gado; os quais vendo a terra de Jazer e de Gileade, pareceu-lhes a terra lugar de gado.
verses.en_web: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. When they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that behold, the place was a place for livestock;
verses.en_bbe: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a great number of cattle: and when they saw that the land of Jazer and the land of Gilead was a good place for cattle;

verses.en: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,
verses.pt: E vieram os filhos de Gade e os filhos de Rúben, e falaram a Moisés, e a Eleazar o sacerdote, e aos príncipes da congregação, dizendo:
verses.en_web: the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,
verses.en_bbe: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and said to Moses and to Eleazar the priest and to the chiefs of the meeting,

verses.en: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
verses.pt: Atarote, e Dibom, e Jazer, e Ninra, e Hesbom, e Eleale, e Sebã, e Nebo, e Beom,
verses.en_web: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,
verses.en_bbe: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Sebam, and Nebo, and Beon,

verses.en: Even the country which the LORD smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:
verses.pt: A terra que o SENHOR feriu diante da congregação de Israel, é terra de gado, e teus servos têm gado.
verses.en_web: the land which Yahweh struck before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock; and your servants have livestock.”
verses.en_bbe: The land which the Lord gave into the hands of the children of Israel, is a land for cattle, and your servants have cattle.

verses.en: Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession, and bring us not over Jordan.
verses.pt: Portanto, disseram, se achamos favor em teus olhos, seja dada esta terra a teus servos em herança, e não nos faças passar o Jordão.
verses.en_web: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don’t bring us over the Jordan.”
verses.en_bbe: And they said, With your approval, let this land be given to your servants as their heritage: do not take us over Jordan.

verses.en: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?
verses.pt: E respondeu Moisés aos filhos de Gade e aos filhos de Rúben: Virão vossos irmãos à guerra, e vós ficareis aqui?
verses.en_web: Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to the war, and shall you sit here?
verses.en_bbe: And Moses said to the children of Gad and the children of Reuben, Are your brothers to go to the war, while you take your rest here?

verses.en: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD hath given them?
verses.pt: E por que desencorajais o ânimo dos filhos de Israel, para que não passem à terra que lhes deu o SENHOR?
verses.en_web: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which Yahweh has given them?
verses.en_bbe: Why would you take from the children of Israel the desire to go over into the land which the Lord has given them?

verses.en: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.
verses.pt: Assim fizeram vossos pais, quando os enviei desde Cades-Barneia para que vissem a terra.
verses.en_web: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.
verses.en_bbe: So did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.

verses.en: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.
verses.pt: Que subiram até o vale de Escol, e depois que viram a terra, preocuparam o ânimo dos filhos de Israel, para que não viessem à terra que o SENHOR lhes havia dado.
verses.en_web: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which Yahweh had given them.
verses.en_bbe: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they took from the children of Israel the desire to go into the land which the Lord had given them.

verses.en: And the LORD’S anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,
verses.pt: E o furor do SENHOR se acendeu então, e jurou dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s anger burned in that day, and he swore, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And at that time the Lord was moved to wrath, and made an oath, saying,

verses.en: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:
verses.pt: Os homens que subiram do Egito de vinte anos acima não verão a terra pela qual jurei a Abraão, Isaque, e Jacó, pois não me seguiram por completo;
verses.en_web: ‘Surely none of the men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me,
verses.en_bbe: Truly, not one of the men of twenty years old and over who came out of Egypt will see the land which I gave by oath to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; because they have not been true to me with all their heart;

verses.en: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the LORD.
verses.pt: exceto Calebe, filho do quenezeu Jefoné, e Josué filho de Num, que seguiram por completo ao SENHOR.
verses.en_web: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun; because they have followed Yahweh completely.’
verses.en_bbe: But only Caleb, the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua, the son of Nun: because they have been true to the Lord.

verses.en: And the LORD’S anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the LORD, was consumed.
verses.pt: E o furor do SENHOR se acendeu em Israel, e os fez andar errantes quarenta anos pelo deserto, até que foi acabada toda aquela geração, que havia feito mal diante do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, who had done evil in Yahweh’s sight, was consumed.
verses.en_bbe: Then the Lord was angry with Israel, and he made them wanderers in the waste land for forty years? till all that generation who had done evil in the eyes of the Lord was dead.

verses.en: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers’ stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.
verses.pt: E eis que vós sucedestes em lugar de vossos pais, descendência de homens pecadores, para acrescentar ainda à ira do SENHOR contra Israel.
verses.en_web: “Behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, an increase of sinful men, to increase the fierce anger of Yahweh toward Israel.
verses.en_bbe: And now you have come to take the place of your fathers, another generation of sinners, increasing the wrath of the Lord against Israel.

verses.en: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.
verses.pt: Se vos deixardes de segui-lo, ele voltará outra vez a deixar-vos no deserto, e destruireis a todo este povo.
verses.en_web: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all these people.”
verses.en_bbe: For if you are turned away from him, he will send them wandering again in the waste land; and you will be the cause of the destruction of all this people.

verses.en: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:
verses.pt: Então eles se achegaram a ele e disseram: Edificaremos aqui currais para nosso gado, e cidades para nossas crianças;
verses.en_web: They came near to him, and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones;
verses.en_bbe: Then they came to him, and said, We will make safe places for our cattle here, and towns for our little ones;

verses.en: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
verses.pt: E nós nos armaremos, e iremos com empenho diante dos filhos de Israel, até que os ponhamos em seu lugar; e nossas crianças ficarão em cidades fortes por causa dos moradores da terra.
verses.en_web: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place. Our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
verses.en_bbe: But we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel till we have taken them to their place: but our little ones will be safe in the walled towns against the people of the land.

verses.en: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.
verses.pt: Não voltaremos a nossas casas até que os filhos de Israel possuam cada um sua herança.
verses.en_web: We will not return to our houses, until the children of Israel have each inherited their inheritance.
verses.en_bbe: We will not come back to our houses till every one of the children of Israel has come into his heritage.

verses.en: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.
verses.pt: Porque não tomaremos herança com eles ao outro lado do Jordão nem adiante, porquanto teremos já nossa herança da outra parte do Jordão ao oriente.
verses.en_web: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan, and forward; because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.”
verses.en_bbe: For we will not have our heritage with them on the other side of Jordan and forward; because our heritage has come to us on this side of Jordan to the east.

verses.en: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the LORD to war,
verses.pt: Então lhes respondeu Moisés: Se o fizerdes assim, se vos preparardes para ir diante do SENHOR à guerra,
verses.en_web: Moses said to them, “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before Yahweh to the war,
verses.en_bbe: Then Moses said to them, If you will do this, arming yourselves to go before the Lord to the war,

verses.en: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the LORD, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,
verses.pt: E passardes todos vós armados o Jordão diante do SENHOR, até que tenha expulsado a seus inimigos de diante de si,
verses.en_web: and every armed man of you will pass over the Jordan before Yahweh, until he has driven out his enemies from before him,
verses.en_bbe: Every armed man of you going across Jordan before the Lord till he has overcome and sent in flight all who are against him,

verses.en: And the land be subdued before the LORD: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the LORD, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the LORD.
verses.pt: E seja aquela terra subjugada diante do SENHOR; logo voltareis, e sereis livres de culpa para com o SENHOR, e para com Israel; e esta terra será vossa em herança diante do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: and the land is subdued before Yahweh; then afterward you shall return, and be guiltless towards Yahweh, and towards Israel; and this land shall be to you for a possession before Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: And the land is under the rule of the Lord: then after that you may come back, having done no wrong to the Lord and to Israel; and this land will be yours for your heritage before the Lord.

verses.en: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the LORD: and be sure your sin will find you out.
verses.pt: Mas se assim não o fizerdes, eis que havereis pecado ao SENHOR; e sabei que vos alcançará vosso pecado.
verses.en_web: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against Yahweh; and be sure your sin will find you out.
verses.en_bbe: But if you do not do this, then you are sinners against the Lord; and you may be certain that your sin will have its reward.

verses.en: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.
verses.pt: Edificai-vos cidades para vossas crianças, e currais para vossas ovelhas, e fazei o que saiu de vossa boca.
verses.en_web: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”
verses.en_bbe: So get to work building your towns for your little ones, and safe places for your sheep; and do as you have said.

verses.en: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.
verses.pt: E falaram os filhos de Gade e os filhos de Rúben a Moisés, dizendo: Teus servos farão como meu senhor mandou.
verses.en_web: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben said to Moses, Your servants will do as my lord says.

verses.en: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:
verses.pt: Nossas crianças, nossas mulheres, nossos gados, e todos nossos animais, estarão aí nas cidades de Gileade;
verses.en_web: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock, shall be there in the cities of Gilead;
verses.en_bbe: Our little ones, our wives, and our flocks, and all our cattle, will be there in the towns of Gilead;

verses.en: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord saith.
verses.pt: E teus servos, armados todos de guerra, passarão diante do SENHOR à guerra, da maneira que meu senhor disse.
verses.en_web: but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before Yahweh to battle, as my lord says.”
verses.en_bbe: But your servants will go over, every man armed for war, before the Lord to the fight, as my lord says.

verses.en: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:
verses.pt: Então os encomendou Moisés a Eleazar o sacerdote, e a Josué filho de Num, e aos príncipes dos pais das tribos dos filhos de Israel.
verses.en_web: So Moses commanded concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the children of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: So Moses gave orders about them to Eleazar the priest and to Joshua, the son of Nun, and to the heads of families of the tribes of the children of Israel.

verses.en: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the LORD, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:
verses.pt: E disse-lhes Moisés: Se os filhos de Gade e os filhos de Rúben, passarem convosco o Jordão, todos armados para a guerra diante do SENHOR, logo que aquela terra for subjugada diante de vós, lhes dareis a terra de Gileade como propriedade;
verses.en_web: Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man who is armed to battle, before Yahweh, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;
verses.en_bbe: And Moses said to them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben go with you over Jordan, every man armed for the fight before the Lord, and all the land is given into your hands, then let them have the land of Gilead for a heritage:

verses.en: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.
verses.pt: Mas se não passarem armados convosco, então terão propriedade entre vós na terra de Canaã.
verses.en_web: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”
verses.en_bbe: But if they do not go over with you armed, they will have to take their heritage with you in the land of Canaan.

verses.en: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the LORD hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Gade e os filhos de Rúben responderam, dizendo: Faremos o que o SENHOR disse a teus servos.
verses.en_web: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As Yahweh has said to your servants, so will we do.
verses.en_bbe: Then the children of Gad and the children of Reuben said, As the Lord has said to your servants, so will we do.

verses.en: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be ours.
verses.pt: Nós passaremos armados diante do SENHOR à terra de Canaã, e a propriedade de nossa herança será desta parte do Jordão.
verses.en_web: We will pass over armed before Yahweh into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”
verses.en_bbe: We will go over armed before the Lord into the land of Canaan, and you will give us our heritage on this side of Jordan.

verses.en: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, even the cities of the country round about.
verses.pt: Assim lhes deu Moisés aos filhos de Gade e aos filhos de Rúben, e à meia tribo de Manassés filho de José, o reino de Seom, rei amorreu, e o reino de Ogue, rei de Basã, a terra com suas cidades e termos, as cidades da terra em redor.
verses.en_web: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.
verses.en_bbe: So Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad and the children of Reuben and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon, king of the Amorites and Og, king of Bashan, all the land with its towns and the country round them.

verses.en: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
verses.pt: E os filhos de Gade edificaram a Dibom, e a Atarote, e a Aroer,
verses.en_web: The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Gad were the builders of Dibon and Ataroth and Aroer;

verses.en: And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,
verses.pt: E a Atarote-Sofã, e a Jazer, e a Jogbeá,
verses.en_web: Atrothshophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,
verses.en_bbe: And Atroth-shophan and Jazer and Jogbehah;

verses.en: And Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.
verses.pt: E a Bete-Ninra, e a Bete-Harã: cidades fortificadas, e também currais para ovelhas.
verses.en_web: Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran: fortified cities, and folds for sheep.
verses.en_bbe: And Beth-nimrah and Beth-haran: walled towns and shut-in places for sheep.

verses.en: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,
verses.pt: E os filhos de Rúben edificaram a Hesbom, e a Eleale, e a Quiriataim,
verses.en_web: The children of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Reuben were the builders of Heshbon and Elealeh and Kiriathaim;

verses.en: And Nebo, and Baal-meon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.
verses.pt: E a Nebo, e a Baal-Meom, (mudados os nomes), e a Sibma: e puseram nomes às cidades que edificaram.
verses.en_web: Nebo, and Baal Meon, (their names being changed), and Sibmah. They gave other names to the cities which they built.
verses.en_bbe: And Nebo and Baal-meon, (their names being changed,) and Sibmah: and they gave other names to the towns they made.

verses.en: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it.
verses.pt: E os filhos de Maquir filho de Manassés foram a Gileade, e tomaram-na, e expulsaram aos amorreus que estavam nela.
verses.en_web: The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein.
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Machir, the son of Manasseh, went to Gilead and took it, driving out the Amorites who were living there.

verses.en: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.
verses.pt: E Moisés deu Gileade a Maquir filho de Manassés, o qual habitou nela.
verses.en_web: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.
verses.en_bbe: And Moses gave Gilead to Machir, the son of Manasseh; and he made it his living-place.

verses.en: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havoth-jair.
verses.pt: Também Jair filho de Manassés foi e tomou suas aldeias, e pôs-lhes por nome Havote-Jair.
verses.en_web: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its villages, and called them Havvoth Jair.
verses.en_bbe: And Jair, the son of Manasseh, went and took the towns of Gilead, naming them Havvoth-Jair.

verses.en: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
verses.pt: Também Noba foi e tomou a Quenate e suas aldeias, e chamou-lhe Noba, conforme seu nome.
verses.en_web: Nobah went and took Kenath, and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
verses.en_bbe: And Nobah went and took Kenath and its small towns, naming it Nobah, after himself.
